title: Dr. Fatih Dagdelen Shares Safer Alternatives in Aesthetic Procedures, Highlighting Smarter Choices in Lip Enhancement | User | dailytimesleader.com
text:
With more than 32 years of experience, over 80,000 successful operations, and global recognition in the field of aesthetic surgery, Dr. Fatih Dagdelen is once again leading critical conversations about patient safety and natural results in cosmetic procedures. Speaking from his base in Istanbul at Dora Hospital, Dr. Dagdelen shared insights on the risks associated with high-volume filler and the growing preference for lip lift surgeries over traditional lip fillers.
A pioneer in Turkey’s aesthetic and cosmetic surgery landscape and a leader in health tourism, Dr. Dagdelen emphasized that patient health must always come before temporary aesthetic trends. "Aesthetic applications should be planned not only with short-term beauty concerns but also with health in mind. It is possible to achieve both safe and satisfactory results thanks to the procedures applied in the right hands with the right technique," says Dr. Dagdelen.
Addressing the Hidden Dangers of High-Volume Fillers
In his latest public commentary, Dr. Dagdelen warned about the potential systemic health risks linked to excessive filler use, especially in body contouring procedures.
"Unfortunately, these fillers can spread from the injection site to the chest wall, abdomen, armpit, or buttocks, and thus to the leg," Dr. Dagdelen explains. "This situation is not only an aesthetic problem but can also turn into a systemic problem that threatens the general health of the patient."
The Istanbul-based cosmetic surgeon advocates for customized surgical planning and professional teamwork to ensure both beauty and safety. "Don't risk your health for aesthetic appearance," he cautions. "Let's decide together which method is right for you. With customized planning and professional teamwork, we guarantee both an aesthetic and safe process."
Lip Lift Surgery: A Natural and Permanent Alternative to Lip Fillers
Reflecting broader global trends, Dr. Dagdelen also discussed the growing popularity of lip lift surgery as a superior alternative to frequent and excessive lip filler applications. According to recent studies and extensive clinical experience, lip lift procedures provide a more balanced, natural, and long-lasting enhancement of the lips compared to injectable fillers.
Scientific research, including findings published in the Aesthetic Surgery Journal, indicates that lip lift surgeries naturally turn the upper lip upward, enhance facial balance, and achieve a youthful, aesthetically pleasing look without the complications associated with fillers — such as asymmetry, sagging, or tissue degeneration.
"Superficial solutions should not lead to deep health problems," says Dr. Dagdelen, highlighting the importance of choosing safe, evidence-based treatments administered by skilled, ethical professionals.
Based on his decades of clinical observations, Dr. Dagdelen notes that repeated use of lip fillers often leads to irreversible tissue changes, sagging, and an unnatural smile where teeth visibility diminishes over time. In contrast, when performed by an experienced surgeon, lip lift surgery provides subtle, elegant results, especially for patients with naturally thin lips or an elongated upper lip area.
Dora Hospital: A Legacy of Excellence in Aesthetic Surgery
Founded in 2004 by Dr. Fatih Dagdelen, Dora Hospital quickly became one of Istanbul's premier destinations for aesthetic and cosmetic surgery. Located in the central Fulya district, the hospital blends advanced medical technologies with a personalized, patient-first philosophy.
Over his storied career, Dr. Dagdelen has not only built a trusted brand in Turkey but has also played an instrumental role in promoting the country as a leading hub for aesthetic surgery clinics and health tourism. His patients hail from Europe, the Middle East, and across the globe, drawn by his reputation for combining artistry, precision, and an unwavering commitment to ethical medical practice.
Looking forward, Dr. Dagdelen and his team plan to expand Dora Hospital’s international reach, invest in next-generation medical technologies, and continue participating in global scientific forums to ensure patients benefit from the latest advancements in cosmetic and reconstructive surgery.
Distinctive Qualities that Define Dr. Fatih Dagdelen
Dr. Dagdelen’s influence in the field is backed by 13 key pillars that set him apart:
Expertise and Experience: Over 30 years of dedicated service in aesthetic surgery.
Innovative Approach: Adoption of cutting-edge surgical techniques and technologies.
Pioneering Health Tourism: Significant contributions to Turkey's global standing in medical tourism.
Commitment to Perfection: Operating with the motto "Do it Once, Do it Right."
Continued Learning: Regular participation in international congresses and symposiums.
Academic Contribution: Author of influential scientific articles.
Revision Surgery Expertise: Excellence in correcting complex surgical cases.
Patient Satisfaction: Delivering personalized, high-quality service.
Mentorship: Guiding the next generation of plastic surgeons.
Strategic Location: Operating from the centrally located Dora Hospital in Fulya, Istanbul.
Ethical Standards: Deep commitment to professional ethics.
Global Recognition: Trusted name in Europe and the Middle East.
About Dr. Fatih Dagdelen
Dr. Fatih Dagdelen is among Turkey’s most respected names in aesthetic and cosmetic surgery, renowned for his innovative practices, global patient base, and dedication to excellence. With over 80,000 successful surgeries to his name, he continues to set new benchmarks in cosmetic enhancement, reconstruction, and health tourism.
